The Morning Minute (11.20)

⏰Top News:
-Crypto majors are very red post-ANT IPO; BTC at $61.5k
-ANT pops to $105 on IPO, settles at $97 ($88 premarket)
-Apple teases its own autonomous AI agent
-BTC ETFs record $582M in outflows, now over $1B on the week
-Coinbase targets H1 2027 to launch its own prediction market

🌎 Macro, Crypto and Markets
-Crypto majors are very red down 3-6%; BTC -3% at $61.5k; ETH -3% at $1,740; SOL -4% at $71; HYPE -7% at $63.4; ZEC -14% at $811
-Stable (+4%) and JST (+2%) led top alt movers
-Oil -1% at $83; Gold -3% at $3,580
-Stock futures are very red as ANT sells off post-IPO; DOW -0.1%, Nasdaq -1.8%

-Apple is building its own autonomous AI agent that would write code, browse the web and control apps on a user’s behalf

-Bitcoin slipped into a death cross with its 50-day EMA falling below the 200-day, while RSI sank to 21

-Blockstream researchers published a security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme now the apparent frontrunner to replace Bitcoin’s current signatures

-Sen. Ruben Gallego, the Democrat who negotiated the market structure bill that collapsed in September, summed up crypto’s political prospects under the incoming Democratic Congress in two words: “They’re fucked.”

-CFTC Chair Michael Selig said onchain venues like Hyperliquid must register or partner with a licensed exchange to offer leveraged derivatives to US retail, pointing to Backpack’s DCM, DCO and FCM stack as the template

-More than $1.5 billion in USDC fled Sky’s Peg Stability Module after a CoinDesk investigation found $518 million of illicit-linked transactions running through it, including $101.9 million tied to North Korean actors

-Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet said he’s leaving at the end of 2026 after nine years, departing a day after the company confirmed its tampered-device investigation had spread to Europe and the Middle East

-MoonPay applies for National Trust Bank Charter to grow its custody and stablecoin business

Corporate Treasuries & ETFs
-The Bitcoin ETFs saw $582M in net outflows on Thursday; the ETH ETFs saw $131M in outflows

Meme Coin Tracker
-Meme leaders were very red; DOGE -5%, SHIB -5%, PEPE -9%, PENGU -8%, TRUMP -8%, SPX -13%, Bonk -8%
-Robinhood chain leaders were very red; Pons -15% to $67M; Cashcat -4% at $41M; AI -19% at $20M; Orbio -35% at $10M
-Solana top movers included Fiona +83x, Loosy +48x and Nio +90%; Stonk -20% at $33M, Ansem -12% at $37M

💰 Token, Airdrop & Protocol Tracker
-Hyperliquid led onchain protocols in revenue with $3.13M, followed by http://Pump.fun at $1.27M and Polymarket at $509k
-Coinbase is targeting the first half of 2027 to launch its own prediction market contracts for US retail and institutional customers, moving its Kalshi partnership

🚚 What is happening in NFTs?
-NFT leaders were mostly flat; Punks even at 28.24 ETH, BAYC -1% at 5.95 ETH, Pudgy even at 2.2 ETH
-Jpeg Frens (+15%) and Kodas (+7%) led top movers
